In This Week's Money Matters, I speak with Anil, a 24-year-old supporting his family while trapped in high-interest debt taken primarily for his younger brother’s medical treatment. With the family’s entire income falling short of their monthly repayments, years of compounding interest have made escaping the debt nearly impossible.
